dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Rhino-orbital (rhinocerebral) mucormycosis caused by Mucorales infection, occurring in the setting of newly diagnosed diabetes mellitus and concurrent COVID-19.

Alternatives to consider:
1. Invasive orbital aspergillosis (though the non-septate hyphae favor Mucorales over septate Aspergillus).
2. Bacterial orbital/sinus cellulitis with secondary invasive spread.
3. COVID-19-associated orbital inflammatory disease without fungal infection.
